Woah, check out this abandoned cabin! It’s filled with all the foil and non-foil cards from the Camp Totally Safe Superdrop. Kinda weird that they’re all strewn across the ground, on top of that big red paint stain. I guess someone didn’t finish redecorating last summer. Never mind all that—let’s grab those cards!
